Post 1

📉 Tech saved face but couldn't save the index. ASX 200 fell 73.3pts or 0.80% to 9,115.20, down 1.60% on the week. Materials cratered while IT surged — a session of two markets running in opposite directions. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

IT led all sectors, +2.83%. Materials was the wreckage, -2.58%. Industrials fell -1.38%, A-REITs -0.78%. Utilities quietly gained +1.03%. The growth-vs-resources split is sharpening fast. #ASX #mining #tech

Post 3

🔺 SEK surged 9.13% to AUD 15.18, the session's standout. WiseTech added 5.55% to AUD 43.38. Tech found buyers hard even on a down day — the sector rotation story is real. #ASX #tech #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,145.26/oz. Silver AUD 91.78/oz. With materials off 2.58% today, metals prices aren't translating to miner gains — the sector is being sold despite commodity support. AUDUSD at 0.7064. #gold #silver #ASX #commodities

Post 5

ASX sits 1.95% below its 52-week high after a rough week. Can IT hold the line if materials keep sliding? Watch whether that sector split widens or closes — your call below. #ASX #ausbiz #investing
